{"metadata":{"description":"deepseek harness 全局提示词/对话提示词，错误记录功能插件","id":"gh:1418691015","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-prompt-ErrorNotes-desk","slug":"1015677515/dsh-prompt-ErrorNotes-desk","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"deepseek harness 全局提示词/对话提示词，错误记录功能插件"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-prompt-ErrorNotes-desk"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> 本项目由 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 智能体独立开发。"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"对话标题栏里的两个小面板：编辑提示词、维护错误经验库。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## 它做什么"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"| 面板 | 作用 |"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| **提示词** | 编辑**跨对话**的全局提示词，以及**只对本对话生效**的提示词（每个对话一个 Markdown 文件，切换对话即切换提示词，互不影响）。面板顶部显示哪一半当前正在生效。 |"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"
| **错误库** | **按分类**归纳反复犯的错误：每条一个简短类型 + 一句教训，归入三档分类之一。**最近 10 条（条数可自己设）会被注入系统提示词**，让后续对话以极低的 token 成"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"本吸取教训。agent 按格式汇报「我犯了个错误：错误经过：… 教训：…」时会被自动捕获成待确认草稿。 |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"第二个面板的意义：一个反复犯同类错误的 agent，会在自己的上下文里收到一份简短的、按分类归好的提醒，成本远低于重新踩一遍坑再发现。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"**点面板以外的空白处会自动关闭**（按 Esc 也可以）。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## 界面预览"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**错误经验库** —— 按分类折叠，每条带下拉框可改类；顶部显示注入条数，底部是自动捕获的待确认草稿："},{"id":"p13s1","text":"**提示词** —— 顶部自检状态与「临时暂停注入」，中间是全局与本次对话提示词，底部是实际注入文本的预览（可拖拽调高，也可隐藏；三个框都能竖向拖动）："},{"id":"p14s1","text":"## 安装"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"本插件目前只发布在 GitHub（未发布到 npm）。"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"> 完整的安装步骤、验证方法与常见问题见 **INSTALL.md**。下面是最短路径。"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 方式一：应用内安装（推荐）"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"**设置 → 插件 → 安装**，在输入框里填 GitHub 短地址："},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"也可以填完整网址："},{"id":"p21s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"安装界面提示「输入插件的包名、GitHub 仓库地址或本地目录路径」，上面两种都是它接受的写法。"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"**不需要自己写 commit SHA。** 填不带版本后缀的短地址即可：市场会先把默认分支的 HEAD 解析成 40 位 commit SHA，再把 `github:owner/repo#<sha>"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"` 这种已固定的形式交给 pnpm。这样 lockfile 里记录的是可追溯的提交，安装后**版本号能正常显示**。"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"> ⚠️ 反过来要注意：**不要**自己写 `#HEAD`，也不要让安装源停留在会移动的分支上。源码里写明，HEAD 形态的 tarball「installs perfectly and then r"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"eports no version forever」——能装上，但版本栏会一直是空的，之后也检测不到更新。"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### 方式二：本地目录"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"已经克隆到本地时，直接填目录路径（安装界面会提示「本地目录」）："},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### 环境要求"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| 依赖 | 要求 |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.1 || >=0.3.0-rc.1 || >=0.4.0-rc.1 || >=0.5.0-rc.1 || >=1.0.0-rc.1` |
| Node | `^"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| HTTP 服务 | 必需。宿主半边注册 `GET\|POST /prompt-desk/state`，浏览器半边靠它读写。没有 HTTP 服务的 "},{"id":"p31s3","text":"profile 会加载插件但保持不活动，而不是报错 |"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"无第三方运行时依赖；浏览器半边只用页面已提供的 `react`，没有构建步骤。"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"| Panel | What it does |"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"| **Prompt** | Edits the cross-conversation global prompt and a per-conversation prompt that is **sc"},{"id":"p35s2","text":"oped to this conversation only** (each conversation owns one Markdown file under `prompt-desk/sessio"},{"id":"p35s3","text":"ns/`). Shows which half is currently reaching the model. |
| **Error library** | Recurring mistakes "},{"id":"p35s4","text":"grouped **by category** — a short type plus a one-sentence lesson each, filed under one of three top"},{"id":"p35s5","text":"-level categories. The most recent 10 (a configurable number) are injected into the system prompt, s"},{"id":"p35s6","text":"o a later turn can absorb them cheaply. A message reporting 「我犯了个错误：错误经过：… 教训：…」 is captured automat"},{"id":"p35s7","text":"ically as a draft awaiting confirmation. |"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"The point of the second panel: an agent that keeps repeating the same class of mistake gets a short,"},{"id":"p36s2","text":" categorised reminder of it in its own context, at a token cost far below re-discovering the mistake"},{"id":"p36s3","text":"categorised reminder of it in its own context, at a token cost far below re-discovering the mistake."},{"id":"p37s1","text":"**Clicking anywhere outside an open panel closes it** (Escape works too)."},{"id":"p38s1","text":"### Requirements"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"| Dependency | Requirement |"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.1 || >=0.3.0-rc.1 || >=0.4.0-rc.1 || >=0.5.0-rc.1 || >=1.0.0-rc.1` |
| Node | `^"},{"id":"p40s2","text":"22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` |
| HTTP server | Required. The host half registers `GET\|POST /prompt-desk/s"},{"id":"p40s3","text":"tate`; the browser half reads and writes through it. A profile without an HTTP server loads the plug"},{"id":"p40s4","text":"in and it stays inactive rather than failing |"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"No third-party runtime dependencies; the browser half uses only the `react` the page already provide"},{"id":"p41s2","text":"s, and there is no build step."},{"id":"p42s1","text":"## What it does to your files"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"The global prompt **is** the harness's own `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` — the same file the official `dsh-a"},{"id":"p43s2","text":"gent-instructions` plugin already loads. This plugin keeps no second copy: two files both claiming t"},{"id":"p43s3","text":"o be "the global prompt" would drift, and only one of them would actually reach the model."},{"id":"p44s1","text":"| Data | Location |"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"| Global prompt | `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` |
| Session prompt, error library, panel visibility | `$DSH_"},{"id":"p45s2","text":"HOME/prompt-desk/state.json` |"},{"id":"p46s1","text":"Writes are atomic (`.tmp` sibling + rename), so a crash cannot truncate your prompt. The browser hal"},{"id":"p46s2","text":"f never touches the filesystem — all I/O lives on the host half, so nothing can write outside `$DSH_"},{"id":"p46s3","text":"r touches the filesystem — all I/O lives on the host half, so nothing can write outside `$DSH_HOME`."},{"id":"p47s1","text":"## You can always see what the model actually reads"},{"id":"p48s1","text":"- **Injection preview**: a monospace block in the prompt panel showing the plugin's **entire contrib"},{"id":"p48s2","text":"ution**, sent verbatim. It is produced by the **same builder** the assembler calls, so the two canno"},{"id":"p48s3","text":"t drift — which is the whole point (a bare "N entries" count says nothing about the wording).
- **In"},{"id":"p48s4","text":"stall self-check**: one status line at the top of the prompt panel reporting whether the Host half l"},{"id":"p48s5","text":"oaded, whether the HTTP route is reachable, where the state file lives, how many entries are injecte"},{"id":"p48s6","text":"d, whether anything awaits confirmation, and **whether the panel and the Host are on the same versio"},{"id":"p48s7","text":"n**. A mismatch tells you to refresh — the bundle and the Host are loaded by different machinery, so"},{"id":"p48s8","text":" after a rebuild one is routinely a version ahead."}],"truncated":true}
